title: Defer unqualified pure DAG engines and close M7 S01 research
commitMessage: docs: qualify pure DAG deferral and close M7 S01

contribution.summary: Complete M7-W01-C03-S01-T2 by a documented owner-gated deferral of public DAG runtimes and AURA orchestration. Reverify RS111's SHA-pinned pure diamond and no-partial-refusal oracles, require three admission triggers and close S01 as research only. Keep S02, original C03, W01 and M7 unfinished; no product DAG engine or renderer delivered.
contribution.value: A BCL-only read-only gate checks exact prior DAG source hashes and the finite root-13/shared-once, cycle, identity, node/edge/depth/overflow refusals. The negative decision separates Math pure calculations from AURA scheduling, and records consumer/semantics/provider/rights/RID/source-free requirements for any later adoption.
debtChanges: Pure four-node DAG research does not deliver a public evaluator, asynchronous scheduler or shared mutable execution system.
Future DAG adoption needs a real Math caller, immutable identity/alias and explicit pure node, graph budget, cancellation and no-partial-result semantics.
Managed/native provider admission needs exact source, license/notices, version/RID, reproducible offline tests and an isolated source-free consumer.
AURA owns orchestration and permissions; no Math-owned work queue, renderer, task engine or cross-repository cutover is authorized.
S02 PlotModel, size-L original C03, M7-W01 and M7 remain incomplete despite S01 documentary completion.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS112 success, prepare M7-W01-C03-S02-T1 to independently qualify finite 1/x sampling, discontinuity segment breaks, nonfinite refusals and point quotas, without creating a chart renderer or AURA executor. Keep original C03 aggregate planned until both child research phases qualify.

achievements.achievement: Define exact consumer, graph identity/alias, cancellation, resource and owner-gated re-entry criteria for a pure DAG runtime.
Reverify SHA-pinned RS111 root-13 shared-once DAG and cycle/invalid/overflow no-partial-result reference oracles.
Explicitly defer public DAG engines and AURA job scheduling, recording three independent future admission triggers.
Qualify S01 T2 DAG ownership/budget deferral in a read-only C# source gate without product implementation.
Close size-M pure DAG study with independently witnessed reference oracles and a documented no-runtime owner decision.
